sn21.5:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Sujāto yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || || 3
sn21.5:1.3: Addasā kho Bhagavā ayasmantaṃ Sujātaṃ dūrato va āgacchantaṃ || ||
sn21.5:1.6: vata || || Yañ ca abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato || || Yassa catthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyam pabbajanti || tad anuttaram brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti || || 5
